items.claim: Chanel Dyer is a clean, technical, and nasty striker who hits hard.
items.quote: Chanel Dyer is a nasty striker. She's big, she's strong, she hits hard as [__] she's clean, and she's technical.

items.claim: Elise Reed can be knocked out.
items.quote: And she is fighting somebody who can be knocked out in Elise Reed.

items.claim: Jackson McVey struggles with takedown defense.
items.quote: he has giant holes in my opinion in the takedown defense.

items.claim: Wesley Schultz is a pure wrestler whose striking absolutely sucks.
items.quote: Wesley Schultz is a wrestler through and through. It's not even worth talking about anything else because his striking absolutely sucked.

items.claim: Gage Young is durable, tough, moves forward, and will work in some takedowns.
items.quote: Gage Young is durable. Gage Young throws like crazy. He moves forward... He'll work in some takedowns as well.
